Title: Generally Available: Azure Bastion shareable link expiration

Body.Content:
Azure Bastion shareable link expiration is now generally available. When creating a shareable link, administrators can specify the date and time when the link should expire. 

After the configured expiration time, the link can no longer be used to connect to the target resource. This helps organizations limit persistent access and better manage temporary connections provided through Azure Bastion. 

Learn more.
